results.text: And who are your competitors in this kind of bolt-on deals? So for flatline, I think that we are among the sole player more or less to have an appetite for acquisition and you don't have a lot of targets in uniform. So a lot of family business has more started with flat linen than uniform. So that's why I will not say that we are bolt-on for acquisition. But very often, we are long, and it is a question of is it a good moment or not for the family to sell. But if they want to sell, they know that it will be probably Elis. I think we have questions, yes. There's a first question up. Do you see in Mexico, any impact of Trump's policies on our clients since the beginning of the year?
